name: How do I choose the right contractor for home storm damage repairs?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for home storm damage repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a licensed, accredited contractor who performs hands-on structural and finish carpentry rather than an out-of-state storm-chasing sales operation. Companies like HH Remodeling provide an owner-operated approach where an experienced contractor personally leads the job site, ensuring drywall, tile, and framing meet strict quality standards. Check for an A+ Better Business Bureau rating, established local ties, and verified expertise in residential remodeling to ensure the team that rebuilds your home will be available long after the storm season ends.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a local, BBB-accredited remodeling contractor with hands-on job leadership, proven finish carpentry skills, and verifiable local references.
